AUTHOR: Huang
TITLE: Hierarchical classification with reject option for live fish recognition
SPECIES: 15 most common reef species (e.g., Dascyllus reticulatus, Amphiprion clarkii, Chromis chrysura, Plectroglyphidodon dickii, Myripristis kuntee, Lutjanus fulvus) + 3220 images of unknown species
DATA: Live fish image dataset from underwater observation cameras in south Taiwan sea (Fish4Knowledge; not named as such in text); 24,150 labelled images; plus 3 real videos (1000 detections each)
V_EV: Sec. 4, Fig. 6 caption: 'Hard fish examples, due to blurry conditions, different distances/orientations, against coral or ocean floor backgrounds.'
D2: 5-fold CV (train 3/5, test 1/5, validation for feature selection); trajectory-grouped
D_EV: Sec. 4.1: 'The training (3/5’s) and testing sets (1/5’s) are isolated so fish images from the same trajectory sequence are not used during both training and testing.'
R_EV: Sec. 4.3: 'We choose 3 underwater videos and have labelled 1000 detections from each video.' (same observation system/dataset; no other domain)
C_EV: Sec. 4.2: 'set a small threshold (i.e. 0.01) to reject all samples whose posterior probabilities are below the threshold'; Table 7 reports false detections/true and false rejections on manually labelled detections
E_EV: Table 1: 'Fish recognition results (before rejection)' reported only as AR/AP/AC; no ecological variable derived
ARCH: Hand-crafted features (2626-dim) + Balance-Enforced Optimized hierarchical SVM tree (BEOTR) + GMM/Bayes posterior reject option; trajectory voting
METR: Average recall, average precision, accuracy over count, F1, true/false rejection rates
NOTE: Classification of detected fish crops, but per-instance posterior threshold and reject option present, so normal C rules applied. C3='기타' = GMM-based posterior probability used as reported/evaluated reject score (debatable; C_ALL=Y regardless via C5+C1). C5: Sec 4.3 manually labelled 1000 detections per video and reports false detections and rejections. D1: 5-fold CV with trajectory-level grouping (not video-level), coded k-fold(이미지)+D4=Y. V: only qualitative mentions (blurry images, frequently changing illumination); no measurement. NVID 보고됨 refers to the 3 real videos in Sec 4.3; number of source videos for 24,150 images not stated. Unknown-species rejection test uses images from the same camera system (not external).
